experiments_proposed.name: shadow-drift-archive-fallback
experiments_proposed.rationale: The drift_clean and live_regime_discrimination gates, and /api/bot/shadow/drift, read only the ACTIVE shadow_predictions.jsonl. Rotation (ict-shadow-log-rotate.timer, enabled, size-triggered, observed firing 2026-07-07/08-05/09-01/09-26 -- a ~25-29 day cadence) resets that file to empty, and the endpoint's default reference_days=30/current_days=7 window (~37 days) is LONGER than the observed rotation cadence, so no drift verdict this repo has ever fed into a Tier-3 decision was computed on a full, un-truncated reference window, and for roughly the first 1-2 weeks after every rotation the gate is fully blind (reference_count=0) rather than merely thin.
experiments_proposed.input_changes: src/web/api/routers/shadow.py's drift handler (and/or ml/gate_check.py's drift_clean gate) would need to fall back to the rotated .jsonl.gz archives under runtime_logs/ when the active log alone cannot fill the reference window.
experiments_proposed.expected_metric_signal: A drift read taken right after a rotation returns a populated reference_count instead of insufficient_data, and a historical backtest of past 'significant' drift verdicts against an archive-inclusive re-computation shows whether any past demote proposal (E72's btc/sol) would have read differently on a true 37-day window.
experiments_proposed.next_step: PR touching src/web/api/routers/shadow.py + ml gate-check's drift consumption, read/observability-path only (Tier-1 per docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md's tier table); out of this skill's scope to implement (ml-review may not touch src/) -- filed as PI-20260927-YZRZQ725-0001 for a build lane.
